comparison.objective: Bread every face of a chicken tender while minimizing unnecessary gripping.
comparison.physical_skill: Coverage-aware turning, pressing granular coating onto irregular surfaces, and gentle food handling.
comparison.success_condition: All faces have adequate breading with limited gripping and without loss or unsafe handling.
comparison.reason: The task concerns surface coverage and gentle reorientation of food, with no precision tool alignment or impact-mediated separation.
